title: Overload
notes: Overload (X) is the printed name of the next-turn rider of -X (spec 6.3 Overload X, R1848004); wording only, no script or number changed.

player.title: Overload
new: Overload (X) is a new keyword: you have X less mana next turn.
text: Speciesist, Medina Outfitter, Expedition12, Expedition123 and Fortify Mind print their next-turn loss as Overload.
Core System, Secure System, Legacy: Snom Bunny Mind Control, Impact Reactor and Foreshadow do too.
Jlarna's credit line is repaid as Overload over the next turns.
